correctness.rationale: The proof justifies phase indexing through a strictly positive imaginary Wronskian of I_{i nu}, uses the convergent Macdonald small-argument series through x^2 with x-derivative control, and solves the nondegenerate Riccati critical equation. Direct algebra yields (nu^2+9)/(4(1+nu^2)^2) and the additive offset -3/2-2/(1+nu^2). The embedded high-precision code is supplementary only.

value.rationale: The nodal minima are exactly the natural sharp constants in a published family of Turán inequalities. A geometric ratio leaves their absolute scale unspecified, whereas the gamma phase resolves it by index. The nonzero additive term yields a precise finite correction and a quantitative approximation with exponentially decaying absolute error, useful for evaluating the sharp constants at high nodal index.
